# Exact software versions (COBIDAS reproducibility)

fMRIPrep      : 21.0.2 (public derivatives, ds002748) and 25.2.x (planned for robustness)
GIFT          : gift-master (trendscenter), MOO-ICAR
NeuroMark 2.2 : fMRI 2.2, 105 networks, modelorder-multi. PRIMARY network identification (Studies 1 and 2).
NeuroMark 1.0 : fMRI 1.0 template (Neuromark_fMRI_1.0.nii). Used for the network-definition SENSITIVITY branch (Study 2 posterior/whole/anterior DMN; see docs/05_results.md, Level 2).
MATLAB        : R2026a (26.1.0.3276743, Update 3)
SPM           : SPM12 (template reslicing)
NBS toolbox   : 1.2
Python        : 3.13
nilearn       : 0.14.0
nibabel       : 5.4.2
